entries.21a00bb0a4631ab4: This business manufactures and sells household goods, including stainless steel vacuum bottles. It is a reportable segment separate from the gas business. Principal companies are Thermos K.K. and Zenmashi (China) Household Products Co., Ltd. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥33,263 million (up 2.1% year on year), making it the smallest business. In Japan, revenue rose, as sales of sports bottles were solid, mainly in the first half, due to the extreme heat, and a new product was launched. In South Korea, revenue declined.

entries.5ca9f13edd19cf6d: In the United States, this business manufactures and sells industrial gases such as oxygen, nitrogen, argon, hydrogen and dry ice, specialty gases and gas-related equipment, and sells cutting equipment. The main company is Matheson Tri-Gas, Inc. (renamed Nippon Sanso Matheson, Inc. effective April 1, 2026). Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥360,557 million (up 0.1% year on year), the second largest business. Industrial gases saw weak shipments of products and merchandise, but revenue increased due to the effect of price management. In equipment and construction, electronics-related revenue decreased.

entries.8aef146514edc4e0: In Japan, this business manufactures and sells industrial gases such as oxygen, nitrogen, argon, helium and hydrogen, specialty gases including electronic material gases, LP gas and medical gases, and manufactures and constructs gas-related and electronics-related equipment. Cutting equipment and laser processing machines, liquefied carbon dioxide and dry ice, and sales and rentals of medical equipment are also included here. The main companies are Taiyo Nippon Sanso Corporation (renamed Nippon Sanso Corporation effective April 1, 2026), NISSAN TANAKA Corporation, Nippon Ekitan Corporation, Nippon Megacare Corporation and I.M.I. Corporation, among others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥406,296 million (down 0.9% year on year), the largest of the five reportable segments. In industrial gases, price management had an effect on carbon dioxide, packaged gases and electronic material gases, but revenue decreased as shipment volumes of separate gases and LP gas fell. In equipment and construction, revenue increased in electronics-related business due to progress in construction for medium- and large-scale projects, while revenue in industrial gas-related business decreased.

entries.d9d831b2b3389f57: In Europe, this business manufactures and sells oxygen, nitrogen and argon, provides home healthcare services, and sells medical equipment. The main companies are Nippon Gases Euro-Holding S.L.U. (renamed Nippon Sanso Euro-Holding S.L.U. effective April 1, 2026), Nippon Sanso Homecare España, S.L.U., Nippon Gases Belgium NV, Nippon Gases Industrial S.r.l., among others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥350,978 million (up 6.8% year on year), the third largest business. Gas shipment volumes declined, but revenue increased due to the effect of exchange rates and price management. In equipment and construction, revenue increased due to solid performance in medical-related equipment and construction, and the addition of revenue from an Italian plant engineering company acquired in the previous fiscal year.
entries.e0fea8889db4087e: This business manufactures and sells industrial gases such as oxygen, nitrogen and argon, and specialty gases, and sells welding-related equipment and gas-related equipment, in Southeast Asia, China, Taiwan, South Korea, Australia and other regions. Principal companies include Nippon Sanso Holdings Singapore Pte. Ltd., Leeden National Oxygen Ltd. (renamed Nippon Sanso Singapore Ltd. effective April 1, 2026), Coregas Pty Ltd and Taiwan Nippon Sanso Co., Ltd., among others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥208,452 million (up 18.1% year on year), making it the fourth-largest business. In industrial gases, revenue rose as the LP gas sales business in Australia, acquired in the previous fiscal year, and the industrial gas business in Oceania, acquired in the current fiscal year, were added. In electronics-related business too, revenue increased because shipment volumes of electronic materials gases were recovering and equipment and construction was solid.
